title: What must you do with your ball on each hole?
question: In general, what must a player do with the same ball they played from the tee on each hole?

choices.text: Pick it up after a few shots
Change it for a different one on the putting green
Play it into the hole (hole out)
Skip the putt if it's very short

explanation: Players must play the same ball from the tee all the way into the hole, unless the rules allow them to change it.
imagePrompt: A teenage boy lining up a putt on the green, focusing on playing his original ball into the hole for completion of the hole.
imageAlt: Teenage boy putting on the green, concentrating on holing out.
